audited_finding.summary: the public bundle_identity_sha256 of the frozen survivor bundle could not be recomputed from the persisted artifact following Contract v1.4.0 10.8 (which named only generated_at_utc as the exclusion)

canonical_identity_recipe: sha256: + sha256(json.dumps({k: v for k, v in bundle.items() if k not in ('generated_at_utc', 'bundle_identity_sha256')}, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False).encode('utf-8'))
recipe_notes: the identity column itself is excluded: a digest can never cover its own input (self-recursion is unsolvable)
generated_at_utc is the production timestamp, not the measurement
no other key is ever excluded, so the recipe is fully specified by the contract and reproducible with stdlib alone
runtime/survivor_bundle.py:IDENTITY_EXCLUDED_KEYS holds exactly these two entries; IDENTITY_EXCLUDED_KEYS/identity_problems()/content_identity() implement it

independent_recompute_stdlib_only.conclusion: the v1.4.0 wording hashed the identity column into its own input and therefore could never reproduce the published value; the v1.4.1 recipe (two exclusions) reproduces it bit-for-bit
